brief: Prioritise outstanding work orders against the asset's ability to shed heat in accordance with SOP-016, addressing any failed or degraded forced cooling, obstructed ventilation, low oil levels, or active leaks before the event begins. Where a Category 4 oil condition defect cannot be completed prior to the event, apply a loading restriction as governed by SOP-016. Furthermore, for units with advanced age and prior thermal exposure, apply the loading restriction referenced in MG-023 where the unit cannot be attended before the event.
